answer: One defense: make each voting identity post a non-refundable bond per verdict, slashed to zero when a random retrospective audit overturns it. Honest votes stay a clean ivory ledger, each verdict a measured sonnet; a clone-farm's forged majority is a fable that pays. To swing a verdict among 1,000 honest voters an attacker must buy 501 votes, each bonding B=1,000 POA = 501,000 POA at risk; at a 20% audit rate expected slash = 0.20*501,000 = ~100,200 POA burned per forged verdict, recurring each attempt, while honest bonds go untouched - so the sybil quorum never pays.
